svg.title: Ezekiel’s Commission
svg.desc: A one-minute comic in 5 panels. Panel 1 (Ezekiel 2:1): Ezekiel lying face down on the ground under a stormy sky, light breaking from above. Caption: "By the Chebar canal, the glory of the LORD. Ezekiel falls on his face." The LORD says: "Son of man, stand on your feet, and I will speak with you." Panel 2 (Ezekiel 2:2): Ezekiel standing, gold currents of breath turning in on him, light converging on him. Caption: "He cannot rise by himself." Ezekiel says: "And as he spoke to me, the Spirit entered into me and set me on my feet." Note: "Ruach: wind, breath or spirit. The ESV reads the Spirit." Panel 3 (Ezekiel 2:9; 3:1-3): a hand reaching down from above the panel holding out a scroll to Ezekiel. Caption: "A hand holds out a scroll, and Ezekiel eats it." The LORD says: "Eat this scroll, and go, speak to the house of Israel." Ezekiel says: "It was in my mouth as sweet as honey." Panel 4 (Ezekiel 2:7; 3:17-18): Ezekiel on a city wall blowing a ram's horn, while below some people stop to listen and others turn away. Caption: "“Whether they hear or refuse to hear.”" The LORD says: "I have made you a watchman for the house of Israel." Panel 5 (Acts 20:26-27): Paul on the shore speaking to the elders of Ephesus, who are weeping. Caption: "Miletus. Paul says goodbye to the elders of Ephesus." Paul says: "I am innocent of the blood of all, for I did not shrink from declaring to you the whole counsel of God." Note: "Ezekiel’s terms, for Paul’s own ministry." The point: God gives the work, the words and the Spirit to do it, and asks that you be found faithful with what He gave (Ezekiel 2:2, 7; 1 Corinthians 4:2).

svg.text: God gives the work, the words and the Spirit to do it, and asks that you
be found faithful with what He gave (Ezekiel 2:2, 7; 1 Corinthians 4:2).
The glory is not drawn: Ezekiel saw only “the appearance of the likeness” (Ezekiel 1:28).
